description: A progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by memory loss, cognitive decline, accumulation of amyloid-beta plaques, and neurofibrillary tangles.

associations.disease_role: Parent protein of Amyloid-beta peptides; mutations cause autosomal dominant familial Alzheimer's disease.
Hyperphosphorylated tau aggregates into neurofibrillary tangles causing neuronal destabilization.
Catalytic core of gamma-secretase complex responsible for cleavage of APP into amyloid-beta fragments.
Major genetic risk factor (APOE epsilon4 allele); involved in lipid metabolism and amyloid-beta clearance.
Transmembrane aspartyl protease that executes rate-limiting beta-cleavage of APP.
Pro-inflammatory serine/threonine kinase that hyperphosphorylates tau protein.
Component of the gamma-secretase complex involved in intramembrane proteolysis of APP.
Main alpha-secretase responsible for non-amyloidogenic processing of APP, neuroprotective.
